result.reason: The clause does not reach the fallback because the 12-month restriction runs from termination of the Agreement rather than from the end of each employee’s involvement in the services, potentially extending the restriction substantially longer than permitted. It is mutual, limited to directly involved personnel, contains general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and does not impose a no-hire restriction. However, the additional contact requirement and six-month departed-employee carve-out go beyond what is necessary to implement the fallback. Drafting is generally professional, though “this engagement” is less precise than the playbook’s services-based formulation.
